title: ctxpipe check toolchain
description: What `scripts/checks/toolchain.mjs <manifest>` writes: the toolchain, the platform and the hashed environment of the job that runs the checks. A result cache adds them to the key of a check. A reader that only computes keys (the merge gate select job) reads this record instead of its own toolchain. The OS and the architecture use the names of the Rust standard library (std::env::consts). The record never holds an environment value as text.

bun.description: Absent when Bun is not installed. A check of a Bun lane then has no key.

programs.description: The version of each host program that a check of the manifest declares in `programs`: the major and minor version of `git --version`, the first dotted number of `ast-grep --version`, and the Go module version of `zoekt-webserver` (`go version -m`). A program that is not installed is absent; a check that declares it then has no key.

env.description: NODE_OPTIONS, TZ and each variable that a check of the manifest declares in `env`: `unset`, or `sha256:` and the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the value.
